description.value: The AU PD Responder is a system responsible for providing responses to queries submitted by AU PD Requesters.

documentation.value:
An AU PD Responder, also known as AU PD Server:
- **SHALL** correctly populate all *Must Support* elements if they know a value for the element.
When a *Must Support* element requires additional or stronger obligation, this obligation is specified in the AU PD Responder [obligation extension](https://hl7.org/fhir/extensions/StructureDefinition-obligation.html) on the element definition.
